products.name: Specify
products.valueProposition: Transform requirements into specifications in minutes
products.description:
### Overview

Development specification tool that converts natural language requirements into executable specifications. Eliminates ambiguity, reduces scoping time by 90%.

### Key Features

- Natural language processing for requirement extraction
- Automatic edge case identification
- Test case generation
- API specification creation

### How It Works

- Input: Business requirements in plain English
- Processing: AI extracts entities, actions, constraints
- Output: Complete technical specification with test cases

### Technical Stack

Next.js, Claude API, PostgreSQL, Vercel
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- API-first design works with any system
- Can be used standalone or integrated into existing workflows
- Minimal setup required

### Setup Time

- 2 weeks for full deployment
- Can be tested immediately with demo access

products.name: RideShare Albania
products.description:
### Overview

Carpooling platform optimized for Albanian geography and payment preferences. Focus on inter-city routes underserved by public transport.

### Market Opportunity

- 60% of inter-city routes have limited public transport
- Average savings: 70% vs. taxi
- Environmental impact: 3 tons CO2 saved per active user yearly

### Localization

- Cash payment integration
- Route optimization for Albanian road conditions
- Trust system through social verification

### Technical Stack

React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Maps API
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- Mobile app (iOS and Android)
- Web dashboard for administration
- Payment gateway integration

### Setup Time

- 6 weeks for full launch
- Beta testing available in 3 weeks

products.name: PropertyMatch AI
products.valueProposition: Find unlisted properties through social graphs
products.description:
### Overview

AI platform matching property seekers with unlisted inventory through social graph analysis. Solves information asymmetry in Albanian real estate.

### The Problem

- 40% of properties never publicly listed
- Word-of-mouth dominates transactions
- Price opacity benefits sellers

### The Solution

- Social graph analysis for hidden inventory
- Fair market value estimation
- Anonymous initial inquiries
- Trust scores through transaction history

### Technical Stack

Graph database, ML valuation model, Next.js
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- Social login for network analysis
- Property data API integration
- Valuation model training on local data

### Setup Time

- 5 weeks for beta launch
- Initial data collection in 2 weeks
